environment.description: Service deployed on EKS behind an AWS ALB with target group routing. ALB performs TLS termination with a standard ACM certificate. The X-User-ID header is set by an OAuth2 proxy sidecar (oauth2-proxy) running in the same pod. Any user with a valid OAuth2 session from the corporate IdP can connect. No channel-level authorization is enforced anywhere in the stack.

config.ingress: AWS ALB with ACM TLS termination
config.auth: oauth2-proxy sidecar sets X-User-ID from OIDC token
